item.text: {"search_note":"I found clear implementation evidence in economics, welfare, and diplomacy, but little independent proof that Sisi’s 2024 “reform” language produced durable institutional change beyond IMF-monitored macro policy and a few official procedural moves. The strongest pro-implementation items are often official Egyptian statements or externally supervised program documents; the strongest contrary items are independent rights reports. I did not find solid independent evidence that the July 2024 cabinet reshuffle or August pretrial-detention directive produced broad, sustained downstream change by year-end.","evidence":[{"title":"IMF Reaches Staff Level Agreement on the Third Review of the Extended Fund Facility with Egypt","publisher":"IMF","date":"June 6, 2024","url":"https://www.imf.org/en/news/articles/2024/06/06/pr-24208-egypt-imf-reaches-agreement-on-the-3rd-review-of-the-eff","summary":"The IMF says Egypt stayed the course on fiscal discipline, tight monetary policy, a flexible exchange-rate regime, and structural reforms, with improving FX availability and inflation easing.
